template_data.lead_html: She was waiting on her 8(a) before she'd even look at the Schedule. She'd been waiting two years.

rows.what_html: "I need my 8(a) first" — the most common cert misconception I hear
Schedule has no cert requirement — 8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB multiply what you already have
Schedule approved. 8(a) pending. — now running both tracks at once
